item_name: Rothco Touch Screen All Purpose Duty Gloves
item_short_desc: Rothco's lightweight all-purpose duty gloves feature a moisture wicking, polyester spandex fabric, synthetic leather palm & fingers for grip and durability, finger and knuckle patches, and elastic cuff with hook & loop wrist closure. The pads on the thumb and index finger allow you to use any touch screen device without removing the gloves.
